headline_marked: 2 Bangladeshis dead, 24 injured in [[Riyadh airport missile strike]]
headline: 2 Bangladeshis dead, 24 injured in Riyadh airport missile strike
summary: A missile hit Terminal 3 of King Khalid International Airport, leaving 12 people dead and 309 injured, including dozens of Bangladeshis.
details: Two Bangladeshis, Shahed Ahmed from Bogura and Nasrullah Badarpuri from Cumilla, were killed when a missile struck Terminal 3 of King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh on October 10.
Twenty-four other Bangladeshis were injured in the attack, including 11 workers and 13 Umrah pilgrims. They are currently receiving treatment at various hospitals across Riyadh.
According to the Bangladesh Embassy in Riyadh, the strike occurred at approximately 3:15 AM. The total casualty count for the attack is 12 dead and 309 injured.

Three Bangladeshis are in critical condition in the ICU of King Abdullah Hospital, while others are being treated at National Guard, Riyadh Medical, Prince Sultan Military, and several other healthcare facilities.
The attack caused massive disruptions, leaving approximately 500 passengers, including many Bangladeshis, stranded. The embassy has arranged for accommodation and food at hotels and dormitories.

Special arrangements were made to transport 67 Umrah pilgrims to Jeddah by bus, while around 400 passengers on a cancelled Saudi Arabian Airlines flight to Dhaka were rerouted via Dammam's King Fahad International Airport.

headline_marked: Uber driver [[crushed to death by APC wheel]] in Uttara, ICT says
headline: Uber driver crushed to death by APC wheel in Uttara, ICT says
summary: The International Crimes Tribunal-2 has detailed the killing of Mokshlesur Rahman (Durjoy) and the subsequent attempt to hide the body in the Turag River.
details: The International Crimes Tribunal-2 has ordered the formal framing of charges against 26 accused in a case involving the killing of 11 people, including Mir Mahfuzur Rahman Mugdho, during the July uprising in Uttara.

The tribunal detailed that on July 18, 2024, Uber driver Mokshlesur Rahman (Durjoy) was crushed to death by the rear wheel of an APC. Police officers, with the help of local Awami League leaders, allegedly attempted to hide the body.
According to the tribunal, the body was first kept in a water pump room at the Uttara East Police Station before being dumped in the Turag River near IC Hospital in Sector 8 that night.
The body was later recovered by Tongi East Police on July 20 from the Marukun Beel area near the Maruka Bridge in Tongi.
The tribunal also highlighted the killing of Mugdho, an MBA student who was shot while distributing water and biscuits to protesters and injured persons on July 18.
A total of four charges have been brought against the accused, including the shooting deaths of Mugdho, Mokshlesur Rahman, and others on July 18 and 19.

Eight of the accused are currently in custody, including former Additional SP Mirza Salauddin and former OC of Uttara East Police Station Md. Mojibur Rahman. They denied the charges, claiming they are innocent.
Eighteen other accused, including former MP Habib Hassan and former DMP Commissioner Habibur Rahman, remain at large.
